How to use TruckoRig: Amazon Relay journal, disputes, weekly goal, diesel, paychecks, taxes, map, reports, Telegram, widget, and backups.

On Home tap Add load and pick a method: paste a Relay, Telegram, or email message, fill in the form, or upload a photo/PDF. You need a rate above zero and a pickup or delivery address. Save — the load appears in the journal with miles and RPM. If the trip has not started yet, you can set a start alarm.

The Loads tab lists the selected period: this or last week, yesterday, this month, calendar, or archive by year. Search by Trip ID, city, or date. The header shows count, total, miles, and average RPM. Open a card to edit, mark finish, or attach photos and scans.

On the load card check Dispute and pick a response date — the load is marked In dispute (red chip). The Dispute filter on Home shows active disputes. When it is closed, tap Completed: the chip changes to Was disputed and stays on the card.
In the Goal tab set a weekly gross target. The app tracks progress, how much is left, how many days remain, and the daily pace you need.

Menu → Diesel opens the fill journal. Pick a week, All days, or a specific date. Each card shows date, location, amount, gallons, price, and discount; the week total is at the top. Plus (+) opens the add form. From the widget or by saying add diesel you go straight to the form.

Menu → Paycheck opens the payout journal. You see every previous paycheck; pick a week or search by amount and file. Tap a card to edit the amount; tap the file name to open the original. Plus (+) opens the form: file/photo, Telegram, or enter the amount. In My numbers, paycheck and diesel sit side by side in color — no subtraction.
Menu → Taxes: a quarterly estimate from load gross, diesel deduction, and per diem ($69/day). It is a guide, not tax advice.
Menu → Reports: weekly and route income, paycheck and diesel side by side in color (no subtraction), and CSV export.
Menu → Map: your RPM by origin state for the week, month, or year. Tap a state for recent rates and top lanes.
Documents is the scan gallery — open, share, or delete. From a load card or the widget you can take a photo or scan a document and attach it to a load from this week.
Menu → Maintenance: reminders by miles or date (oil change and the like) and a service-receipt archive — photograph a receipt and the app reads the service, amount, and date.
Add the TruckoRig home-screen widget: weekly gross and goal, RPM, plus camera, scanner, and Add diesel buttons.
In Settings add a bot token from @BotFather. The on-device bot reads messages and adds loads, paychecks, and diesel to the journal.
In Settings create a backup file on the phone or save to Google Drive and restore when you change devices.
Settings covers language, theme, RPM thresholds, sounds, privacy, Telegram, and backup. Profile holds driver info. The left menu opens every section of the app.
